key_insight: Agentic Symbolic Search (ASYS) combines PDE theory, prior constraints, and evolutionary search to discover interpretable symbolic formulas for PDE behavior, rather than only numerical or neural approximations.
engineering_relevance: ASYS could help engineers obtain compact, human-readable surrogate laws for complex PDE systems, supporting analysis, design decisions, and downstream control or simulation workflows.
method: Agent uses PDE theory, problem constraints, and past search experience to propose testable symbolic programs.
Evolutionary search refines the mathematical structure of candidate expressions.
Gradient-based optimization fits continuous parameters in the discovered formulas.
evidence_signal: Across five PDE problems spanning bounded dynamics, finite-time blow-up, and free-boundary focusing, the method recovered known analytical forms when available and produced new interpretable formulas when closed forms were unknown.
watch_item: The approach may be sensitive to the quality of prior guidance and search settings, so results could depend on problem-specific constraints and optimization stability.
paper_title: Agentic Symbolic Search: Characterizing PDEs Beyond Hand-crafted Expressions, Meshes, and Neural Networks
